title: 扇出型面板級封裝
summary: 以 12 個技術單元、24 步分析與驗證深入大面積均勻性、面板變形與拼接對位。逐一建立剖面、測試見證、失效判別和可審查的驗收證據。
summaryEn: Twelve technical units and 24 analysis/verification steps explore large-area uniformity, panel distortion and stitching, building sections, test witnesses, failure discrimination and reviewable acceptance evidence.
scope: 公開工程原理與原創教學推理；數值是明示假設的算例，不是生產配方或供應商規格。各單元先建立物理模型，再設計能區分失效機制的量測。24 步是學習工作包，完整量產需經授權設備、材料及產品資格驗證。
scopeEn: Public engineering principles and original educational reasoning. Numbers are explicitly hypothetical examples, not production recipes or supplier specifications. Each unit builds a physical model then measurements that discriminate failure mechanisms. The 24 steps are learning work packages; production requires qualified equipment, materials and product validation.

stages.title: 面板布局

stages.descriptionEn: Three dedicated units for panel layout, each with physical analysis and measurement diagnosis.

steps.title: 格式與設備邊界｜機制與設計

steps.instructionEn: Build the model for format and tool boundaries: Panel size must fit patterning, deposition, handling and inspection. Mark controlled quantities, responses and handoff interfaces in a section or data table. Compare two cases changing one condition and predict direction. Use this evidence plan: List effective process areas at every station. State how the model could be falsified; a plausible drawing is not a measurement.

steps.title: 曝光拼接｜機制與設計
steps.objective: 針對曝光拼接，把「曝光場接縫需控制位置、尺度和線段連續性。」轉成可驗證的工程判定，明確列出適用範圍與未知量。
steps.objectiveEn: For exposure stitching, turn "Field seams need position, scale and conductor continuity control." into a testable engineering decision with explicit bounds and unknowns.
steps.instruction: 本步先建立「曝光拼接」的模型：曝光場接縫需控制位置、尺度和線段連續性。 在剖面或資料表中標出控制量、受影響量和交接介面；提出一組只改一項條件的比較，寫出預測方向。用「跨接縫設計線阻與套刻見證。」規劃模型將如何被推翻；不要把畫得合理當作已經實測。
steps.instructionEn: Build the model for exposure stitching: Field seams need position, scale and conductor continuity control. Mark controlled quantities, responses and handoff interfaces in a section or data table. Compare two cases changing one condition and predict direction. Use this evidence plan: Use resistance and overlay witnesses across seams. State how the model could be falsified; a plausible drawing is not a measurement.
steps.observation: 跨接縫設計線阻與套刻見證。 請分開列出符合預測與不符合預測的位置或樣本。
steps.observationEn: Use resistance and overlay witnesses across seams. Report locations or samples agreeing and disagreeing with the prediction separately.
steps.failure: 避免：每場內 DRC 通過便無拼接問題。先檢查是否混用基準、忽略局部差異或超出模型範圍，再以本單元量測區分機制。
steps.failureEn: Avoid: Assuming within-field DRC excludes stitching defects. Check for mixed references, missed local variation or extrapolation before using this unit’s measurements to distinguish mechanisms.

steps.checkEn: Submit a section/causal diagram for exposure stitching, a two-case comparison and one falsifying measurement; include units, datums and upstream/downstream interfaces.

Challenge the hypothesis "Assuming within-field DRC excludes stitching defects" and name another mechanism that could give the same appearance. Plan controls, sampling coordinates and repeated measurements; separate observations from inference and identify a hold condition.
steps.observation: 跨接縫設計線阻與套刻見證。 請分開列出符合預測與不符合預測的位置或樣本。

steps.failure: 避免：每場內 DRC 通過便無拼接問題。先檢查是否混用基準、忽略局部差異或超出模型範圍，再以本單元量測區分機制。

steps.instruction: 本步先建立「圖形伸縮補償」的模型：尺寸補償須保留局部設計規則及連接捕捉餘量。 在剖面或資料表中標出控制量、受影響量和交接介面；提出一組只改一項條件的比較，寫出預測方向。用「檢查補償前後線距與過孔重疊。」規劃模型將如何被推翻；不要把畫得合理當作已經實測。 原創算例：假設 500×500 mm 面板四邊各排除 10 mm，可用面積 480²=230400 mm²；20×20 mm 封裝忽略街道時最多 24²=576 個。加街道、測試區及良率後數量必降。 請重算一次，將一項輸入改變 10%，並指出此近似與本單元證據的關係。
steps.instructionEn: Build the model for pattern-scale compensation: Scale compensation must preserve local rules and capture margin. Mark controlled quantities, responses and handoff interfaces in a section or data table. Compare two cases changing one condition and predict direction. Use this evidence plan: Check spacing and via overlap after compensation. State how the model could be falsified; a plausible drawing is not a measurement. Original example: For an illustrative 500×500 mm panel with 10 mm excluded edges, usable area is 480²=230400 mm²; 20×20 mm packages fit at most 24²=576 before streets, test zones and yield. Recalculate, vary one input by 10%, and relate the approximation to this unit’s evidence.

steps.failure: 避免：縮放全圖不會改變電性規則。先檢查是否混用基準、忽略局部差異或超出模型範圍，再以本單元量測區分機制。

steps.objectiveEn: For scale economics, turn "Larger area must account for tool, handling and rework costs." into a testable engineering decision with explicit bounds and unknowns.
steps.instruction: 以先前模型進行證據審查：比較每良品成本及尾端風險。 將「面板越大成本必單調下降」當作待否定假說，另提出一項可能造成相同表象的混淆因素。安排對照樣本、座標和重複量測，分開記錄觀察值與機制推論；指出哪個結果會讓你暫停放行。
steps.instructionEn: Review the preceding model with evidence: Compare cost per good unit and tail risks. Challenge the hypothesis "Assuming larger panels always lower unit cost" and name another mechanism that could give the same appearance. Plan controls, sampling coordinates and repeated measurements; separate observations from inference and identify a hold condition.

steps.observationEn: Compare cost per good unit and tail risks. Report locations or samples agreeing and disagreeing with the prediction separately.
steps.failure: 避免：面板越大成本必單調下降。先檢查是否混用基準、忽略局部差異或超出模型範圍，再以本單元量測區分機制。
steps.failureEn: Avoid: Assuming larger panels always lower unit cost. Check for mixed references, missed local variation or extrapolation before using this unit’s measurements to distinguish mechanisms.
steps.check: 交付規模化經濟的證據表：原始觀察、兩個競爭假說、對照方法、不確定度與接受／暫緩條件；至少一項證據須獨立於主要讀值。
steps.checkEn: Submit evidence for scale economics: observations, two competing hypotheses, controls, uncertainty and accept/hold criteria, including one observation independent of the main reading.
